npcs.name: Jor Sandline
npcs.description: Caravan Master associated with the caravan yard outside the north gate.
npcs.biography: Most days begin the same for Jor Sandline: a 39-year-old Human caravan master moving through the caravan yard outside the north gate as if the stones themselves keep appointments with them. Jor pays in mixed coin to learn who notices, and is rarely without route book bound in camel hide. Deals with Orrin; uses Skog's stables; hires Jab. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to secure Orrin's spice contract exclusively. What keeps them careful is losing a season to bandits or tariffs. To a DM, Jor is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Offered Jab double to deliver to the mill without a waybill copy.

npcs.name: Kavi Greenhood
npcs.description: Wilderness Scout associated with forest margins and game trails.
npcs.biography: Ask around town for a wilderness scout and someone will point you to Kavi at forest margins and game trails. At 128, this Elf has learned which smiles are currency and which are warnings. Kavi leaves stacked stones as silent letters, and is rarely without green hood faded almost gray. Walks with Yara; reports odd trails to Serra sometimes. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to keep a safe trail for pilgrims and herbalists. What keeps them careful is town politics spilling into the woods. To a DM, Kavi is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Found Yara's feverwort patch flagged with chalk arrows toward the mill.

npcs.description: Traveling Minstrel associated with roads, fairs, and Mira's stage.
npcs.biography: Rilo Songpenny works as a traveling minstrel out of roads, fairs, and Mira's stage, a 27-year-old Half-Elf with more town memory than most council minutes. Rilo collects rumors the way others collect coins, and is rarely without cape lined with song scraps. Sometimes rooms with Nessa; carries news. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to be hired by Dame Orla for a full season. What keeps them careful is singing the wrong satire in the wrong hall. To a DM, Rilo is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Heard sailors say Nedda's barge 'rides light and smells bright'.

npcs.description: Pilgrim associated with temple steps and road shrines.
npcs.biography: Most days begin the same for Asha Roadbless: a 50-year-old Human pilgrim moving through temple steps and road shrines as if the stones themselves keep appointments with them. Asha washes her feet before every gate, and is rarely without walking staff carved with mercy marks. Guest of Elen's temple; rejected Orin. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to reach three temples before winter. What keeps them careful is faithful folk turned away for being poor. npcs.name: Blink Feather
npcs.description: Long-Road Courier associated with the long road in all weather.
npcs.biography: Blink Feather works as a long-road courier out of the long road in all weather, a 23-year-old Halfling with more town memory than most council minutes. Blink never sleeps in the same loft twice, and is rarely without sealable message tube worn as a belt. Idol for Finn; professional pride. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to hire Finn as a second when the boy is ready. What keeps them careful is being forced to open a letter. To a DM, Blink is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Carried a sealed note from Kitty Shade to someone inside Vale Manor.
